A '''metabolic stabilizer''' was a drug developed from the pollen of [[water lotus]] which could be used to stabilize the metabolism of [[Kath hound/Legends|kath hounds]].<ref name="RelicHunt">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|the ''Enigma''}}</ref>
